tips.text: Inhale as you raise your hands, and exhale as you lower them.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
Straighten and soften your knees in sync with your hands.
This exercise promotes blood circulation in your shoulders and arms.

introduce:
Stand with your knees slightly bent.

Inhale, sweep your hands back and up to fully open up your chest. Straighten your legs and lift your gaze to the sky.

Exhale, flow your hands downward in front of you and soften your knees.

Imagine yourself gently rowing across a calm, still lake.
name: ROWING THE BOAT

tips.text: Inhale as you sweep your hands upward, and exhale as you flow them down.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
Relax your shoulders and neck.
This exercise opens your chest and relaxes your shoulders.
This exercise improves your balance.

introduce:
Slightly bend your knees.

Exhale and twist your torso to the right while straightening your legs. Guide your arms up and back toward the sky.

Inhale and return your body to the center. Slowly flow your hands back and soften your knees.

Repeat on the other side with a smooth and steady pace.
name: GAZING AT THE MOON

tips.text: Exhale as you twist your torso, and inhale as you return to the center.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise enhances your spinal flexibility.
This exercise helps improve blood circulation.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Exhale, lift your left knee and right arm. Let your right heel naturally follow.

Inhale, slowly lower them.

Imagine gently bouncing a ball as your hand presses down.

Switch sides to repeat.
name: STEP AND PAT

tips.text: Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise strengthens your legs and enhances your balance.

introduce:
Step your left foot out and cross your forearms in front of your chest.

Inhale and lower your body into a squat position, pushing your left hand outward and pulling your right hand back like pulling a bow.

Exhale and extend your right arm. Bring your foot back, relax your arms, and stand upright.

Switch sides to repeat.
name: DRAWING THE BOW

tips.text: Inhale as you lower your body, and exhale as you stand up.
Always keep your chest up and your back straight.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes while squatting.
This exercise opens your chest and improves your breathing.
This exercise strengthens your legs.

introduce:
Lift your palms up to your abdomen.

Inhale to reach your right hand toward the sky and press your left palm downward. 

Exhale, slowly bring your hands back.

Switch hands and repeat.
name: SEPARATE HEAVEN AND EARTH

tips.text: Inhale as you reach up, and exhale as you return.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
Relax your shoulders and keep your spine long.
Focus the strength on the base of your palms.
This exercise helps regulate your spleen and stomach.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body.

introduce:
Stand with your knees sightly bent and palms down.

Inhale, open your arms, straighten your legs, and look back to the right.

Exhale and slowly draw your arms in, returning your head to the center and softening your knees.

Switch sides and repeat with a smooth and steady rhythm.
name: LOOKING BACK TO CURE

tips.text: Inhale as you soften your knees, and exhale as you stand up.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
Keep your spine long, and don’t twist your body.
This exercise relieves your neck tension and opens your chest.
This exercise promotes your blood circulation.

introduce:
Inhale and gently raise your arms. 

Exhale, lower your hands and place them under your armpits. 

Inhale, slide your hands down, past your lower back. 

Exhale, slide along your legs, all the way to your feet.

Inhale to stand upright and repeat.
name: TWO HANDS HOLD THE FEET

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
When bending forward, imagine the spine lowering segment by segment like a chain.
If your hamstrings feel tight, you can bend your knee slightly.
This exercise helps relax your body.
This exercise promotes your blood circulation.

introduce: Inhale, lift your heels off the floor and hold, feeling a lengthening upward through your torso.\n\nExhale, drop your heels naturally, allowing them to bounce slightly upon landing.
name: BOUNCING ON THE TOES

tips.text: Inhale as you lift your heels, and exhale as you lower them.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise promotes blood circulation and improves balance.
This exercise relaxes your body and mind.

introduce:
Stand with your arms relaxed.

Inhale, raise your shoulders toward your ears.

Exhale, roll them forward and down.

Move at a steady pace.

Switch directions and repeat.
name: SHOULDER ROLLS

tips.text: Maintain steady breathing.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
This exercise relieves tension and stiffness in your shoulders.
This exercise calms your mind.

introduce:
Bend your arms and clench your fists in front of your chest.

Circle your wrists slowly inward.

Breathe in and out with a steady rhythm.

Switch direction and circle them outward to repeat.
name: WRIST CIRCLES

tips.text: Relax your shoulders and keep your arms light.
Maintain steady breathing.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
This exercise enhances your wrist flexibility.

introduce:
Gently bow your head forward, then slowly tilt it upward. Return to center.

Lower your head toward your left shoulder, then to your right shoulder. Return to center again.

Repeat at your own pace.
name: HEAD TURNS

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your body relaxed.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise improves your neck flexibility and reduces stiffness.
This exercise relieves your neck tension and promotes relaxation.

introduce:
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. 

Place your hands on your waist.

Circle your hips in one direction. 

Keep your feet grounded and knees soft.

Reverse the direction and repeat.
name: HIP ROTATIONS

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Expand your hip circles as much as you feel comfortable.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
This exercise helps open your hips and release tension.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Place your hands behind your back.

Inhale, lift your left knee and circle it outward from the hip several times.

Switch to the other leg and repeat.

Then repeat the movement, but circle your knee inward.
name: HIP CIRCLES

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
This exercise helps open the hips.
This exercise strengthens your leg muscles.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Place your hands behind your back.

Inhale, lift your left knee and circle your ankle outward.

Then, reverse the circle.

Switch to the other leg and repeat.
name: KNEE AND ANKLE CIRCLES

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Let your calve rotate with your ankle naturally.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
This exercise helps improve your flexibility, balance, and core strength.
This exercise enhances your joint mobility and promotes flexibility.

introduce:
Reach your right hand overhead.

Use your left hand to tap up and down along the right side of your body.

Breathe in and breathe out naturally.

Apply gentle pressure—just enough to feel the release.

Switch sides and repeat.
name: SIDE TORSO TAPPING

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Avoid applying too much pressure with your hands.
Keep your back straight.
Don't shrug your shoulders.
This exercise improves blood circulation in your upper body.
This exercise relaxes your upper body.

introduce:
Place your hands behind your back.

Use your hands to tap up and down along your back.

Breathe in and out naturally.

Tap in a smooth and steady rhythm.
name: BACK TAPPING

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Avoid applying too much pressure with your hands.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise boosts circulation in your back.
This exercise relieves your back tension.

introduce:
Clench your fists in front of your chest.

Gently tap up and down on your chest.

Breathe naturally, keeping a smooth, steady rhythm.
name: CHEST TAPPING

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Avoid using too much pressure with your hands.
This exercise stimulates blood circulation in your chest.
This exercise promotes relaxation and relieves tension.

introduce:
Inhale, lift your shoulders to your ears.

Exhale, lower them naturally. 

Let your knees move naturally with your shoulders.
name: SHOULDER RAISES

tips.text: Inhale as you lift your shoulders, exhale as you lower them.
Don’t tense your neck and keep your jaw soft.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise relieves your shoulder tension and promotes relaxation.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Inhale, open your arms and sweep your right hand overhead. 

Exhale, flow your right hand to the left and shift your weight to the right.

Swing your arms gently from side to side. 

As your arms swing, shift your weight to the opposite leg.
name: PAINTING THE RAINBOW

tips.text: Move in harmony with your breath.
Shift your weight in sync with the flow of your hands.
Let your gaze follow your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
This exercise enhances your body coordination and balance.
This exercise improves your flexibility and stretches your upper body.

introduce:
Bring your hands in front of your chest.

Inhale, rotate to the left and flow your left hand backward.

Exhale, return and push your left hand forward.

Rotate your hands and repeat the flow on the other side.
name: REPULSE MONKEY

tips.text: Inhale as you flow your arm backward, and exhale as you push forward.
Perform the movement slowly and smoothly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Imagine releasing Qi as you pull back and gathering it as you push forward.
This exercise helps improve flexibility in your upper body.
This exercise improves body coordination and balance.

introduce:
Slightly bend your knees.

Bring your hands up as if cradling Qi.

Exhale, push your right palm forward.

Inhale, rotate your hand and slowly draw it back.

Switch hands and repeat.
name: PUSHING PALMS

tips.text: Exhale as you push your palm forward, and inhale as you return.
Imagine pushing the energy forward and drawing it back into your body.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
This exercise enhances your Qi flow and balance.
This exercise improves your arm mobility and flexibility.

introduce:
Start with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Inhale and let your belly relax. Then, on the exhale, engage your core to extend one arm and the opposite leg. 

Hold for five seconds, then go back and repeat with the other side, coordinating with your breaths.
name: BIRD DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your stretched arm and leg parallel to the floor.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Tighten your abs.
Don't lift your arm or leg up too high.
This is a good exercise for your core.
This targets your abdominals and lower back.
This helps you build your endurance and get good balance.
Exhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and inhale when lowering them.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Lie down on your stomach with your legs straight. \n\nPut your hands underneath your nose, squeeze your legs together, then bend your knees to bring your heels towards your butt. Repeat the exercise.
name: HAMSTRING CURL

tips.text: You need to do this on a mat.
Your legs should squeeze together.
Don't move your hips and lower back.
Exhale as you lift your legs, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise targets your hamstrings.
This exercise will give you healthy and pain-free knees.

introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your legs and arms straight. \n\nKick your left leg up to touch your right hand to your toes. Repeat with the other side.
name: TOY SOLDIERS

tips.text: Keep your back and legs straight.
Tighten your abs.
Don't lean your upper body forward.
Exhale as you raise your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise targets the hamstrings and hip flexors.

introduce: Stand or sit on the floor. Raise your shoulders up towards your ears as far as you can, then drop them. Repeat the exercise.
name: SHOULDER SHRUGS

tips.text: Raise your shoulders up as high as you can.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale as you raise your shoulders, and inhale as you drop them.
This exercise can loosen up your neck and upper back.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended to your sides at the shoulder height. 

Then bend your body and use your left hand to touch your right foot or get as close as you can. Switch sides and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. 

Keep your back and legs straight during the exercise.
name: CROSS TOUCH AND REACH

tips.text: Keep your back straight when bending your body.
Bend your body at 90 degrees.
Don't bend your knees.
Exhale as you bend down, and inhale as you come up.
When your arm is up in the air, you should feel stretch from your fingers to toes.
This exercise helps you warm up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings, torso and arms.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bring your knee to your opposite elbow. \n\nReturn to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: STANDING BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
You can feel your entire core squeezing.
Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Raise your arms parallel to the ground, and bend your elbows. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

Repeat this exercise.
name: RHOMBOID PULLS

tips.text: Please squeeze your shoulder blades when pulling your elbows back.
Please keep your triceps contracted.
Exhale when pulling your elbows back, and inhale when going back to the start position.
Too easy? You can hold dumbbells in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back muscles.

introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.

Stretch your arms in front of you at shoulder height with one arm overlap the other in the shape of the letter “X”, and then spread them apart.

Switch arms, and repeat the exercise.
name: ARM SCISSORS

tips.text: Please always keep your arms at shoulder height.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
Exhale as you bring your arms together in a scissoring motion.
Inhale as you open your arms back to the start position.

introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.

Sit your hips back and bend your upper body while keeping your upper body straight, then slowly go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.
name: HIP HINGE

tips.text: Please engage your core.
Please squeeze your glutes as you stand up.
You should feel stretching in your hamstrings as you bend down.
Push your hips back as you bend down.
Please keep your weight on your heels.
Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Rest one hand behind your head and the other at your side. Bend your torso towards the side where your extended arm is and reach that arm toward the floor.

Pause for one second and return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat the exercise.
name: STANDING SIDE BEND

tips.text: Please pause for one second when your bend down.
Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you go back to the starting position.
If it’s too easy for you, you can hold a dumbbell in the hand of your stretched arm.
This exercise works your obliques.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce: Stand upright with your hands beside your ears and elbows facing each side. Rotate your elbows until both of them are facing the front.
name: SHOULDER GATORS

tips.text: Please keep your back straight.
Do not raise or lower your elbows when rotating them.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, chest up and shoulders back. Exhale, lift one knee up, and grab it with both hands.\n\nThen gently pull it towards your body as much as you can. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds, switch sides and repeat.
name: STANDING KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Please keep your body straight when lifting your knee up.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet together, and grab your toes.\n\nOpen your knees to the sides, and press your knees down as much as possible.
name: SEATED BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Press your knees down as much as possible.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise your right knee, and use your left elbow to touch your right knee. Change sides and repeat.
name: KNEE TO ELBOW CRUNCHES

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.

Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your left leg straight on the ground, and your right leg bent with your right foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your left leg and lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your right leg straight on the ground, and your left leg bent with your left foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your right leg and Lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Stand with your hands on your waist. Lift your left leg and move it clockwise in big circles, then move it counterclockwise. Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
name: STANDING HIP CIRCLE

tips.text: Please keep your lifted leg straight.
Please do it slowly to get the better result.
Inhale through your nose and exhale through the mouth.
Breathe in a regular pattern according to your cadence.
This exercise works your hip joints and improves your hip mobility.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bend your arms forward and rest your hands gently behind your head.

Inhale, gently arch your lower back, allowing a subtle lift while keeping your tailbone grounded. Exhale as you press your lower back into the mat, closing the gap.

Repeat with smooth and steady breaths.
name: THE NO-GAP

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes and flatten your lower back on the ground.

Inhale to return and relax your back. Exhale to press your lower back down.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet on the ground and hands on your belly.\n\nSlowly drop your left knee out to the side; then bring it back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: BENT KNEE FALLOUT PILATES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Please do it slowly.
Make sure the other leg stays still as you drop your knee.
Please keep your pelvis steady as you drop your knee.
Exhale as you drop your knee; inhale as you bring it back.
This exercise helps to improve the stability of your pelvis.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart and your arms straight by your sides. \n\nLift your hips up off the ground into a butt bridge position. Lift one knee up towards your chest, and then lower it back without dropping your hips. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: MARCHING HIP RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes as you lift your hips.
Please don\'t tuck your chin.
Exhale through your mouth as you raise one leg off the ground.
Inhale through your nose as you lower the leg down.

introduce:
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.

Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale, shift weight to the right foot, and press the left sole on your inner calf or thigh. Bring your hands to a prayer position at your chest. 

Hold this position with steady breath. With each exhale, relax your shoulders and press your left knee open.
name: TREE POSE RIGHT
